selected_policy: Cigna ACDF (CMM-601: Anterior Cervical Discectomy and Fusion)
missing_information: Documentation of epidural steroid injection(s) or selective nerve root block(s) at the requested level(s) (C5-C6).

Documentation of a full 6-week trial of prescription strength analgesics, steroids, gabapentinoids, and/or NSAIDs (current documentation shows 5.5 weeks of PT and unspecified duration of medication trial).

criterion_evaluations.criterion: Symptoms include significant level of pain on a daily basis defined as clinically significant functional impairment
criterion_evaluations.patient_evidence: Patient describes severe, unremitting daily pain... Significant disability affecting work and daily activities of daily living.

criterion_evaluations.criterion: Symptoms include unremitting radicular pain to shoulder girdle and/or upper extremity resulting in disability
criterion_evaluations.patient_evidence: radiating down the right upper extremity into the shoulder and hand with numbness... Significant disability affecting work and daily activities of daily living.

criterion_evaluations.criterion: Physical exam findings include ANY of the following: dermatomal sensory deficit, motor deficit, reflex changes, shoulder abduction relief sign, nerve root tension sign, or unremitting radicular pain without concordant objective findings
criterion_evaluations.patient_evidence: Motor: 4/5 weakness; Sensory: C6 deficit; Reflexes: 1+ reflex; Provocative Signs: Spurling maneuver is positive.

criterion_evaluations.criterion: Less than clinically meaningful improvement with at least TWO of the following: (1) prescription strength analgesics/NSAIDs/gabapentinoids for six (6) weeks, (2) provider-directed exercise program for six (6) weeks, (3) epidural steroid injection(s) or selective nerve root block(s)
criterion_evaluations.patient_evidence: Completed 5.5 weeks (10 visits) of provider-directed physical therapy... Trial of NSAIDs (Meloxicam 15mg daily) and Gabapentin (300mg TID) with inadequate symptom relief. [No documentation of ESI/SNRB or full 6-week medication trial provided].

criterion_evaluations.criterion: Plain x-rays of the cervical spine (including flexion/extension lateral views) have been performed
criterion_evaluations.patient_evidence: EXAMINATION: CERVICAL SPINE 4-VIEW (AP, LATERAL, FLEXION, EXTENSION DYNAMIC VIEWS)... Dynamic flexion and extension lateral views: Normal

criterion_evaluations.criterion: MRI/CT shows neural structure compression at the requested level(s) that is concordant with the individual's symptoms and physical exam findings
criterion_evaluations.patient_evidence: Target Interspace / Segment (C5-C6): C5-C6 disc extrusion with foraminal compression... Severe neural compression concordant with clinical radiculopathy/myelopathy

criterion_evaluations.criterion: Absence of unmanaged significant mental and/or behavioral health disorders
criterion_evaluations.patient_evidence: No unmanaged major depressive disorder, psychiatric illness, or substance abuse disorder.

criterion_evaluations.criterion: Documentation of nicotine-free status (never-smoker or 6 weeks abstinence validated by objective cotinine testing)
criterion_evaluations.patient_evidence: TEST: URINE COTININE SCREEN (LC-MS/MS) RESULT: Negative... Specimen confirms tobacco / nicotine abstinence (>6 weeks duration)

notes: The request is denied because the patient has not met the medical necessity criteria for conservative management failure. The policy requires less than clinically meaningful improvement with at least TWO of the following: (1) 6 weeks of medication, (2) 6 weeks of physical therapy, or (3) epidural steroid injection/nerve root block. The patient completed only 5.5 weeks of physical therapy (failing the 6-week threshold) and there is no documentation of an epidural steroid injection or selective nerve root block. While the medication trial is documented, the duration is not explicitly stated as 6 weeks, and even if it were, the failure of the PT criterion and the absence of injection documentation means the 'at least two' requirement is not satisfied based on the submitted records.
